name: nose-review
description: Review code generated during a Codex turn for duplication with Nose

interface.shortDescription: Review changed code for duplication before Codex finishes.
interface.longDescription: Compares content fingerprints from prompt-start and final Nose scans, remembers intentional duplication, and requests a read-only review of up to three new families. Overlapping sessions defer review.
defaultPrompt: Review my current code changes for duplication.
